message.content:
This editorial illustration serves as the cover of "TEMPO" magazine, dated "31 JANUARI-6 FEBRUARI 2022." The upper third features the title in large red serif letters above the slogan "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." Secondary headlines include "Mafia Tanah Padang H.72" and "Perbudakan Bupati Langkat H.30."

The central image depicts three men with light skin and dark hair, wearing dark blue shirts. They are waist-deep inside a vast, terraced circular pit that resembles an open-pit mine. The men grip the sandy orange rim of the pit with their hands. The background landscape consists of tiered reddish-brown excavations under a pale yellow and blue sky. Small yellow dump trucks and a red excavator are positioned on various levels of the mine.

At the bottom, white text reads "INVESTIGASI" above a large title: "Hutan Habis Nikel Binasa." Further text below states, "Pejabat, politikus, dan pengusaha berkongsi mengeruk nikel Sulawesi memakai celah hukum yang lemah. Deforestasi setengah juta hektare. H.40." The illustration uses a limited palette of red, orange, tan, and blue with a flat, graphic style.
